annotation.bound_parties_text: The non-binding European Parliament resolution only calls on, urges and encourages the Commission, Member States, EDA and others, and imposes no obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the European Council, the Council, the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative
